body.prompt: A bullet hitting water seen from the side: a tall vertical spray column of white and light blue water with droplets flying outward and a crown splash at the base. Bold simple silhouette, high contrast, chunky shapes, isolated on a plain dark background

assets.prompt: A centered side-view water impact: a tall, narrow column of white water with light-blue shadow sections rises from a broad crown splash. Chunky curved jets form the crown, while separate rounded droplets arc outward around the column. A small dark bullet is partly visible at the point of impact. Use bold, even outlines and hard-edged two-tone cel shading. Keep the entire splash compact and isolated against a solid light-gray background.

body.prompt: A bullet hitting water seen from the side: a tall vertical spray column of white and light blue water with droplets flying outward and a crown splash at the base. Bold simple silhouette, high contrast, chunky shapes, isolated on a plain dark background
